line_ranges: inclusive; paths relative to source_root; every evidence item is at the audit commit

runtime_constraints.fact: Declared php:5.4-apache, America/La_Paz, mysql/mysqli/PDO, port 80; actual deployment and mounts unknown.
Local .env.php and required vendor/autoload.php absent; real routes cannot be validated from this checkout. Inclusion can connect to DB on legacy PHP and was not executed.
Undefined datoconservar constant in anonymous branch raises Error in local PHP 8.4; legacy PHP 5.4 normally continues with notice/string fallback. Custom error handling can differ.
password_verify is not native to PHP 5.4. A nonempty master-password result can abort login without a compatibility provider, which is unverified.
Git submodules intercambioDocumental and servicioNotificaciones unpopulated locally; actual dependencies, include resolution and JWT consumers not verified.

independent_probes.note: Ejecución reproducida con el script guardado. Extrae el código en memoria desde --source y verifica las huellas de cinco archivos revisados; no contiene copias del código de aplicación ni credenciales. El caso antiguo solo define la constante; no ejecuta PHP 5.4. No prueba autenticación completa, persistencia de sesión ni aislamiento entre proveedores.

main_guard_probes.limitation: No proof of tenant ownership, end-to-end authentication, handler execution or deployment safety.

main_php_lint.reason: Unparenthesized nested ternaries rejected by PHP 8.4; not separately counted as security findings.

validation.automated_catalogs: Endpoint candidates, graph coverage, SQL token references, Brownfield sinks/upload markers and raw risk rows were not treated as verified vulnerabilities or DDL.

findings.title: El restablecimiento de contraseña acepta un ID sin autorización de restablecimiento
findings.trace: POST password/identifier -> resetPasswordClient -> SELECT reset record by ID -> account UPDATE. No token, expiry, deleted_at or session grant is required; the separate verification result is enforced only by browser sequencing.
trigger_preconditions: Bootstrap and DB available
Existing reset-record ID for target known or discovered
No authenticated session required by this route's source chain
findings.impact: Unauthorized password replacement for that record's account, including reuse of previously consumed or expired records; subsequent access still depends on active status and other controls.
findings.recommendation: Require and atomically consume an expiring, random, single-use reset grant bound to the verified account; never authorize with a record ID.
findings.validation_result: Prueba reproducida mediante el método extraído: solo identifier y password sintéticos; funciones de base de datos simuladas capturaron dos consultas y éxito sin token. Véase security-probes.json; no se ejecutó SQL real.
limitations: No live endpoint, reset record or affected account tested
Missing local bootstrap dependencies prevent end-to-end execution
findings.summary: El método final cambia la contraseña a partir de un registro de restablecimiento sin exigir token, caducidad ni autorización vinculada a la sesión. Requiere arranque y base de datos operativos y un ID existente.

findings.title: Inyección SQL en la verificación y el cambio final de contraseña
findings.trace: Raw form username/token enter quoted verification SELECT; identifier enters an unquoted SELECT expression; raw password enters SQL MD5() in UPDATE. Escaping on generateToken.php is on another route.
trigger_preconditions: Reset endpoint bootstrap and usable DB connection
Crafted values reach listed SQL contexts
Final UPDATE requires a selected reset record
findings.impact: Altered reset selection/verification and account UPDATE within the DB user's privileges; no stacked-query, OS execution or universal table-access claim.
findings.recommendation: Bind all values with prepared statements, validate identifier types and enforce reset authorization independently.
findings.validation_result: Traced each raw input through complete helper queries; no injection executed.
findings.reference_comparison: Unsafe interpolation retained while execution functions migrate to mysqli.
limitations: Schema, SQL modes, DB privileges and exploitation unverified
findings.summary: Las entradas de verificación y restablecimiento se interpolan en SELECT y UPDATE sin parámetros enlazados; los efectos dependen de la sintaxis y de los permisos reales de la base de datos.

findings.title: La autenticación MFA asigna una identidad aportada por el cliente
findings.trace: POST info -> base64/JSON decode -> session provider/user/type/table/reference assignment, with no password/OTP/pending-challenge validation. Browser verification sequencing is not enforced server-side. OTP query is not account-scoped.
trigger_preconditions: Includes reach autenticar; eager UserFind relative guard inclusion must not terminate anonymous request
Caller supplies shaped identity JSON
Bootstrap dependencies available
findings.impact: Authentication-related session identity assigned without either factor before downstream failures. Successful complete login or post-error persistence is not asserted.
findings.recommendation: Keep pending identity server-side; bind OTP to that identity and consume it before assigning authenticated session fields; regenerate session ID and correct the logging call.
findings.validation_result: Prueba reproducida del método extraído con sesión en memoria y registro simulado que lanza una excepción: se asignaron proveedor y usuario sintéticos sin OTP antes del fallo. Sin JWT, base de datos, red ni sesión persistente.
findings.reference_comparison: Trust defect predates master. Master moves UserFind include earlier and changes log arguments to undefined row fields, adding reachability/failure constraints.
limitations: PHP 8.4 may abort in an eagerly resolved permisos include
Undefined row at TwoFaClass.php:196 can produce malformed logging SQL before JWT generation
No end-to-end authentication or session persistence tested
findings.summary: El método asigna identidad desde JSON sin comprobar los factores. Las inclusiones y un fallo posterior de registro condicionan su ejecución; no se acredita un acceso completo ni persistencia tras el error.

findings.title: La contraseña maestra sustituye a la contraseña individual de la cuenta
findings.trace: Any master_pass hash match sets isValid; selected account passes MD5 equality OR isValid. Active status remains checked; normal non-expired MFA remains selected when enabled.
trigger_preconditions: Valid session-bound login CSRF token
Valid username and knowledge of a master password
Working DB and password_verify implementation; native PHP 5.4 does not supply it
findings.impact: Shared-secret compromise substitutes for the first factor across active accounts. Expired-password branch assigns identity before normal MFA branch; resulting capabilities unverified.
findings.recommendation: Remove universal password acceptance; use explicit privileged, time-limited and separately audited impersonation if needed.
findings.validation_result: Traced master match through account decision; no master secret or database data used.
findings.reference_comparison: Present in reference and master; HSTS change does not address it.
limitations: Nonempty master table without password_verify compatibility on PHP 5.4 can abort before login
No proof of MFA bypass or deployed master credential validity
findings.summary: Una coincidencia global de master_pass sustituye al primer factor para una cuenta activa. Requiere conocer la credencial y disponer de password_verify(); no se acredita su funcionamiento en PHP 5.4 sin compatibilidad.

findings.title: La guardia compartida no termina la denegación cuando PHP antiguo continúa
findings.trace: Denied request emits a browser form but no exit or server-side deny status. Bare constant at line 21 aborts anonymous PHP 8.4; normal PHP 5.4 string fallback permits continuation. Caller borrarempresa has no secondary session condition.
trigger_preconditions: Working handler bootstrap
Legacy/defined-constant continuation and error handling that does not abort
Selected caller has a valid operation without an additional deny guard
findings.impact: Selected mutations can continue despite guard denial on the legacy path. Anonymous mutation on PHP 8.4 is not claimed. Callers requiring missing session SQL operands can fail instead.
findings.recommendation: Return server-side 401/403 and exit before handlers, remove stray constant, and enforce route/object authorization with denial tests.
findings.validation_result: Pruebas reproducidas: la rama autenticada continúa en PHP 8.4; la anónima genera Error; la simulación con la constante definida continúa. session_start se sustituye solo en memoria; no se ejecutó PHP 5.4 ni ningún manejador.
findings.reference_comparison: Master expands short opening tags but preserves the stray constant and missing exit.
limitations: Custom error handlers and runtime constants may change legacy behavior
Must trace individual caller; not a universal anonymous-bypass claim
findings.summary: La denegación solo genera un formulario. PHP 8.4 produce Error en la rama anónima; la continuación habitual de PHP 5.4 puede dejar ejecutar determinados manejadores, según sus controles adicionales.

findings.title: Determinados manejadores de cuentas y negocio concatenan SQL controlado por la solicitud
findings.trace: Raw POST id -> soft-delete WHERE; JSON partida -> quoted LIKE; POST key components -> UPDATE column/ID and raw value; password-change JSON identifier -> old-password SELECT and UPDATE via unchanged HelperClass execution.
trigger_preconditions: Working bootstrap/DB
Conservatively require session idtransportista passing shared guard
Anonymous cases depend on SEC-005 and runtime, not assumed
findings.impact: Query predicate manipulation, broadened mutations/reads and intended password-check selection bypass; damage bounded by actual syntax and DB privileges.
findings.recommendation: Prepared statements; validated integer IDs; explicit editable-column allowlist; bind account and object permissions to authenticated identity.
findings.validation_result: Traced raw input through guards/helpers to execution calls; no queries executed.
findings.reference_comparison: Unsafe interpolation survives migrations from mysql to mysqli; conversion alone provides no injection defense.
limitations: No stacked-query, OS execution or entire-database compromise claim
Actual privileges and rows not tested
findings.summary: Cuatro rutas trazadas incorporan identificadores, valores o columnas de la solicitud a SQL. Se exige conservadoramente una sesión válida; la accesibilidad anónima depende de la guardia y la versión de PHP.

findings.title: Las contraseñas de usuario se almacenan y verifican mediante MD5 sin sal
findings.trace: Login checks MD5; reset and password change write MD5. Modern hashes in master_pass do not protect ordinary account hashes.
trigger_preconditions: User hashes obtained through DB, backups or another disclosure
findings.impact: Fast offline guessing and password reuse compromise; not a standalone demonstrated remote-login bypass.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade runtime; migrate all writers/verifiers to password_hash/password_verify with appropriate cost and opportunistic legacy rehash.
findings.validation_result: Both writer paths and login traced without collecting password material.
limitations: No hash extraction or cracking performed
findings.summary: El acceso y ambos mecanismos de cambio mantienen MD5. Facilita la búsqueda de contraseñas fuera de línea si se obtienen los resúmenes; no demuestra por sí solo una elusión remota.

findings.title: Determinadas modificaciones carecen de validación CSRF en el servidor
findings.trace: Login validates a one-use session token; selected soft-delete routes accept normal form POSTs and common guard validates neither token nor origin.
trigger_preconditions: Victim authenticated with required session
Browser sends cookie on cross-site POST
No upstream origin defense blocks it and target operation otherwise allowed
findings.impact: Cross-site induced authorized mutations under cookie/origin preconditions.
findings.recommendation: Validate cryptographically generated session CSRF tokens on all mutations and appropriate request origins/methods; configure cookie policy before session startup.
findings.validation_result: Verified login defense and complete selected mutation paths separately; did not infer all routes from token search.
findings.reference_comparison: Existing login protection does not extend to business endpoints.
limitations: Native PHP 5.4 does not support SameSite ini setting
Actual cookie/proxy policy unverified
mt_rand login token weakness noted but no prediction exploit claimed
findings.summary: La protección del formulario de acceso no cubre las rutas de modificación seleccionadas. El ataque entre sitios depende de que se envíe la cookie y de la política efectiva de origen.

findings.title: Las lecturas de archivos no comprueban la pertenencia del recurso
findings.trace: Explicit guard session checks and traversal filtering precede filename-based reads. No supplier/trip/customer association is checked before file output; download's extension array is unused.
trigger_preconditions: Session recognized by guard
Known/discovered existing readable relative resource name
Tenant policy restricts that resource to another identity
findings.impact: Potential unauthorized cross-tenant read within configured storage; no arbitrary host-file reading or live tenant breach asserted.
findings.recommendation: Map opaque document IDs through ownership checks and constrain canonical paths/type allowlists.
findings.validation_result: Siete casos reproducibles de guardias y ocho pruebas complementarias de la auditoría general correctos. Se bloquean solicitudes anónimas, rutas superiores y barra inicial de imagen; no se prueba la pertenencia del recurso.
findings.reference_comparison: Master adds effective session/path guards. Previous anonymous/traversal findings must not be carried forward unchanged.
limitations: Tenant access rules and storage policy unverified
No live file requested
Guard probes prove only bounded deny/continue behavior
findings.summary: Las guardias nuevas bloquean solicitudes anónimas y los recorridos comprobados. Tras superarlas no se verifica la asociación del archivo con la identidad; el impacto entre proveedores depende de la política real.

findings.title: Las subidas conservan tipos elegidos por el cliente antes de validar el contenido
findings.trace: Image upload copies bytes with attacker-selected extension after an event query lacking provider scope. Import helper moves basename-preserved upload before caller parses Excel; inspected failure path does not undo move.
trigger_preconditions: Authenticated provider session
Writable configured storage
Matching event for image upload trip
findings.impact: Unvalidated file storage and potential cross-provider trip uploads. RCE requires unverified executable web-serving mapping and is not claimed.
findings.recommendation: Authorize resource first; validate size, type and bytes before storage; server-generated filenames and non-executable storage outside web root.
findings.validation_result: Traced copy/move ordering and guard; no application file uploaded or written.
findings.reference_comparison: Unsafe type retention remains; mysql/mysqli migrations do not remediate it.
limitations: No web execution mapping, parser exploitation or resource-limit testing
No anonymous upload claim on PHP 8.4
findings.summary: Los flujos trazados almacenan contenido con extensiones del cliente antes de validar su tipo; la consulta del evento tampoco limita el proveedor. No se acredita ejecución remota sin conocer la publicación del almacenamiento.

findings.title: El transporte de correo activo desactiva la verificación TLS del certificado
findings.trace: Reset/MFA and shipment callers invoke mail functions that set CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER false while sending bearer auth and mail payloads.
trigger_preconditions: Working cURL/mail path
Attacker can intercept/redirect connection with otherwise untrusted certificate
findings.impact: Mail credential/message disclosure and response tampering, including reset/MFA content.
findings.recommendation: Enable peer verification, retain hostname verification, configure trusted CA bundle and fail closed on errors.
findings.validation_result: Confirmed active first-party callers rather than inferring from bundled library defaults; no TLS/mail request.
findings.reference_comparison: Shared MailClass unchanged; second mail transport also remains in master.
limitations: No network interception test or deployed cURL configuration checked
findings.summary: Los transportes activos envían autorización bearer y mensajes con verificación del certificado desactivada; la exposición requiere capacidad de interceptar o redirigir la conexión.

findings.title: La credencial de correo incluida en el repositorio requiere rotación
findings.trace: Hardcoded mail-service credential at the cited location; value and snippet intentionally omitted.
trigger_preconditions: Access to repository copy/history containing location
Credential still valid and permitted at service
findings.impact: Unauthorized mail-service use if valid; no public HTTP source disclosure or tested credential use is asserted.
findings.recommendation: Revoke/rotate credential, review historical use, and replace literal with controlled secret injection; deletion alone is insufficient.
findings.validation_result: Presence and unchanged assignment verified without displaying value; no service call.
findings.secret_handling: Location-only evidence; no literal, fingerprint or snippet reproduced.
limitations: Validity and permissions not tested
Other redacted metadata locations are leads, not automatically verified vulnerabilities
findings.summary: La ubicación citada contiene una credencial incorporada directamente. Debe revocarse o rotarse y sustituirse por suministro controlado; su vigencia y permisos no se han probado.

findings.title: Se distribuye un punto de entrada phpinfo sin restricción en la aplicación
findings.trace: phpinfo() executed directly; no application guard and no explicit deny in inspected root rules.
trigger_preconditions: File deployed and served as PHP
No upstream/server rule blocks access
findings.impact: Runtime configuration, versions and path disclosure, potentially environment/request values depending on settings; specific credential exposure not established.
findings.recommendation: Exclude diagnostic files from deployable artifacts or restrict to authenticated operations access.
findings.validation_result: Read complete two-line route and root access rules; no HTTP request.
limitations: Actual deployed route and server rules unverified
findings.summary: El diagnóstico carece de guardia y de denegación explícita en las reglas inspeccionadas; su exposición depende del despliegue y de controles anteriores a la aplicación.

findings.title: El registro de acceso serializa la sesión e incluye su JWT
findings.trace: Non-MFA login assigns tokenJWT then passes entire session to saveLog; json_encode of all supplied fields enters log_asgard_cloud INSERT without credential redaction.
trigger_preconditions: Working non-MFA login and JWT generation
Successful log INSERT
Reader obtains table/export/backup access
findings.impact: Authentication material and identity metadata copied into logging storage. Replay depends on downstream JWT acceptance and is unverified.
findings.recommendation: Allowlist log event/identity fields, exclude credentials/tokens and restrict log readers and retention.
findings.validation_result: Traced token assignment and full-session serialization; no log row created.
findings.reference_comparison: Logger moves to mysqli while serialization remains.
limitations: No stored log contents inspected
Unescaped metadata can make INSERT fail
JWT consumers in unpopulated submodule not verified
findings.summary: El flujo sin MFA entrega al registro la sesión completa después de asignar el JWT. El almacenamiento efectivo exige un INSERT correcto; la reutilización del token depende de consumidores no verificados.

findings.title: El exportador acepta operaciones SQL completas del cliente
findings.trace: A hidden form submits complete SQL; POST query is split on xxx; auxiliary segments and then the first segment are passed verbatim to mysqli_query.
trigger_preconditions: Reachable exporter with working bootstrap and applicable access
Usable database connection and grants permitting the selected operations
findings.impact: Caller chooses operations and their order within effective database privileges; production impact and rows are unverified.
findings.recommendation: Select an authorized report query on the server by identifier, bind typed filters and enforce account scope; never accept complete SQL from the caller.
findings.validation_result: 3/3 isolated decoding/dispatch cases; memory substitutes only, no DB, HTTP or application bootstrap.
findings.reference_comparison: New master finding relative to knowledge baseline 3822900; not claimed as a newly introduced application regression. Peru exporter not independently assessed here.
limitations: No anonymous reachability claim
No deployed privileges or rows inspected
Source control flow is not a deployment execution test
findings.dedup: SEC-006 covers interpolation into fixed server SQL. This contract delegates the entire SQL operation and sequence to the client.
findings.summary: El cliente elige consultas completas y segmentos auxiliares. El impacto depende de acceso efectivo, bootstrap y privilegios SQL.

bounded_observations_not_separate_findin.observation: Fixed dig command can log server public IP instead of client; fallback trusts forwarded headers without proxy allowlist. Attribution concern, not command injection; no command executed.
JSON and metadata interpolation can break log INSERT; no DB injection or failed-event completeness claim verified.
mt_rand token generation should be replaced with a cryptographic generator; token prediction was not demonstrated.

credited_controls: Login validates and consumes a session CSRF token before authentication queries.
Login username query uses PDO bound parameter and disables emulated prepares.
Master adds explicit fail-closed session/path guards before download/image bootstrap and reads.
Image parent-path and leading-slash requests are blocked; download parent-path p and basename f handling were traced.
No raw marker count was equated with an exploitable endpoint.
scope_gaps: Production runtime/backports/error handling and include resolution
Missing environment, vendor and submodule implementations
DB schema/privileges/data; SQL references are not DDL
Tenant policy and object ownership tests
Complete endpoint coverage and downstream parsers
Credential validity, service permissions and historical logs
source_integrity: El código de aplicación coincide con el commit auditado, normalizando CRLF/LF, y permanece sin modificaciones. Los entregables contienen únicamente referencias a la credencial, sin su valor ni fragmentos.
summary_text: Quince hallazgos de seguridad: ocho P1 y siete P2. Impacto en producción sin verificar; SEC-015 se incorpora en la revisión iterativa.
